page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What it is
steps.why: A gene from another species is added, so the animal makes a protein it could never make on its own.
common_mistakes: Saying the animal's own genes are removed. A gene is ADDED.
steps.memory_tip: Trans means across: a gene carried across from another species.
lines: Transgenic animals are animals that have had
their DNA manipulated to possess and express
an extra gene in addition to their own

steps.label: An example
steps.why: The human protein made by such an animal can be collected and used as a medicine.
steps.memory_tip: α-1 antitrypsin from a transgenic animal treats emphysema.

lines.text: Example: a transgenic sheep with human AAT

insider_note: The marked words are 'extra gene in addition to their own genome'. An example makes the second mark safe.
